entities.summary: Gertrud Arndt was a German photographer and designer associated with the Bauhaus movement. She is remembered for her pioneering series of self-portraits from around 1930. Gertrud Arndt was a painters & sculptors from Racibórz (1903-09-20, Racibórz–2000-07-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
